name: Hatsujou Saimin Appli ~Shikyuu ni Todoku Chakushin'on~
original_name: 発情催眠アプリ ～子宮に届く着信音～
source:
Our protagonist was killing time playing around with some free app as he usual does.
Then he notices how an unfamiliar app had sneaked its way onto his phone.

"You'll be able to lewd the girls which you record with this app."

What a magnificent app this is!

Even though he knows it is a crime, his mischievous mind takes over and he brings all the girls on his list under the influence of the app to commit perverted acts on them one after the other.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011849.html/?unique_op=af]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角像往常一样用一些免费应用程序消磨时间。
然后他注意到一个陌生的应用程序是如何偷偷进入他的手机的。

“你可以用这个应用程序来猥亵你录制的女孩。”

这是一个多么棒的应用程序啊！

尽管他知道这是一种犯罪，但他顽皮的头脑占据了主导地位，他让名单上的所有女孩都受到应用程序的影响，对她们一个接一个地做出变态的行为。
